ld.description: The rules every arcade game repeats, as three small systems on the kernel: - `waves`: a wave clock, prepare → assault → rebuild, with a spawn budget per wave; - `drops`: pickups that fall, wait to be collected and expire; - `score`: points, a combo that decays, and levels from XP thresholds.

leadHtml:
RULES V0.27.0 COMPLETE

@fzlt/core/rules

The rules every arcade game repeats, as three small systems on the kernel: - waves: a wave clock, prepare → assault → rebuild, with a spawn budget per wave; - drops: pickups that fall, wait to be collected and expire; - score: points, a combo that decays, and levels from XP thresholds. Each is DOM-free, steps without allocating (state lives in typed arrays) and says what happened on the event ring (wave:start, wave:clear, drop:spawn, drop:land, drop:collect, drop:expire, score, combo:end, level), so the HUD, sound, fx and coach layers react without reaching into the game. Defaults are the DOM VIRUS core's (WaveDirector, SupplyDrops) and Null Invaders' numbers, so a port keeps its feel. The game still decides where and what to spawn. Call collect, add and miss from a step, like the rest of the game: their events go on that frame's ring.

rest.html:
EXAMPLE · typechecked against v0.27.0
const w = waves(e, { alive: () => enemies });
const d = drops(e, { kinds: ["repair", "charge"], every: 6, place: (out) => spot(out) });
const s = score(e, { levels: [8, 24, 50] });
e.add({ step() {
  if (w.ready()) { spawn(); w.spawned(); }
  if (d.collect(px, py, 24) === "repair") hp++;
  if (hit) s.add(25, 4);  // 25 points × the combo, 4 xp: event "score"
} });

API

Every export with its signature, parameters, return type, doc comment and status flag, generated at build time from the published type declarations of v0.27.0 by the TypeScript compiler. For AI agents: the whole API as plain text.

WavePhase type COMPLETE

Where the wave clock is: prepare (before a wave), assault (spawning) or rebuild (between waves).

export type WavePhase = "prepare" | "assault" | "rebuild";

WaveOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for waves(): how many are alive now, the cap, the phase lengths and each wave's size, limit and spawn gap.

export interface WaveOptions {
    /** Alive now. A wave clears when it has spawned everything and this reaches 0. */
    alive(): number;
    /** Most alive at once, whatever the wave (default 32). */
    cap?: number;
    /** Seconds before wave 1 (default 4) and between waves (default 8). */
    prepare?: number;
    rebuild?: number;
    /** Enemies in wave n (default min(40, 5 + 5n)). */
    size?(wave: number): number;
    /** Most alive at once in wave n, before `cap` (default 8 + 4n). */
    limit?(wave: number): number;
    /** Seconds between two spawns in wave n (default max(0.7, 2.1 − 0.12n)). */
    gap?(wave: number): number;
}

waves function COMPLETE

A wave clock on engine e, prepare → assault → rebuild, with a spawn budget per wave. It says when to spawn; the game decides where and what. Events: wave:start, wave:clear.

DropOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for drops(): the pickup kinds, the cap, the timer for timed drops, their life and fall.

export interface DropOptions<K extends string> {
    kinds: readonly K[];
    /** Most on the board at once (default 6). */
    cap?: number;
    /** Seconds between timed drops; 0 or left out: only `spawn()` drops. */
    every?: number;
    /** Where the next timed drop lands: write x, y into `out`. Return false to skip this one. */
    place?(out: Float64Array): boolean | void;
    /** Kind of the n-th timed drop, as an index into `kinds` (default: in turn). */
    pick?(n: number): number;
    /** Seconds a drop lasts (default 14), how far it falls (default 60 px) and how fast (default 90 px/s). */
    life?: number;
    fall?: number;
    speed?: number;
}

drops function COMPLETE

export declare function drops<K extends string>(e: Engine, o: DropOptions<K>): {
    system: System;
    /** Positions and kinds of the drops on the board, for drawing: index 0 to `count` − 1. */
    x: Float64Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    y: Float64Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    kind: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    /** Seconds since each drop spawned (fall shadow, blink: `life` − age is the time left). */
    age: Float64Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    /** Where each drop lands: (x[i], landY[i]). Moves with `scroll`. */
    landY: Float64Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    /** Seconds a drop lasts, as configured. */
    life: number;
    readonly count: number;
    /** Has drop i landed (only landed drops can be collected)? */
    landed: (i: number) => boolean;
    spawn: (px: number, py: number, k?: number) => boolean;
    /** The kind of the first landed drop within r of (px, py), removed; or null. */
    collect(px: number, py: number, r: number): K | null;
    /** The page scrolled: move every drop with it. */
    scroll(dx: number, dy: number): void;
    reset(): void;
};

ScoreOptions interface COMPLETE

Options for score(): the combo window and steps (or no combo) and the XP for each level.

export interface ScoreOptions {
    /** A streak lasts `window` seconds after each hit (default 3); the multiplier is
     *  min(max, 1 + floor(streak / step)) (defaults 3 and 5). false: no combo. */
    combo?: {
        window?: number;
        step?: number;
        max?: number;
    } | false;
    /** XP to reach each level after level 0, rising (e.g. [8, 24, 50] gives levels 0 to 3). */
    levels?: readonly number[];
}
